title: Provisions that apply to a retained dwelling
text: Where a dwelling is retained as part of a development it is to comply with the following provisions: 1.1 Private open space - C1.1.1, C1.1.3; 1.2 Trees and landscaping - C1.2.1, C1.2.2, C1.2.3, and C1.2.4; 1.3 Water management and conservation - C1.3.1 and C1.3.2; 2.3 Parking - C2.3.1 and C2.3.5 (minimums only) and C2.3.2, C2.3.6; 2.4 Waste management - C2.4.1 and C2.4.3; 2.5 Utilities - C2.5.1 and C2.5.2; 2.6 Outbuildings - C2.6.1 and C2.6.2; 3.4 Lot boundary setbacks - C3.4.1, C3.4.3, C3.4.4, C3.4.5, C3.4.6 (applicable only to newly created lot or site boundaries).

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf
